simple.meaning: to exist , i.e. be or become , come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הָיָה (H1961) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3575 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הָיָה (hâyâh) means to exist , i.e. be or become , come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 10.
